# Listing Mend

> Google Business Profile setup, repair, suspension appeals and monthly upkeep for local service businesses (plumbers, HVAC, roofers, cleaners, contractors and similar) in Oklahoma and North Texas. Based in Lawton, OK. Work is done remotely; no office visits needed.

## Contact and booking
- Email: help@listingmend.com (fastest; replies within one business day)
- Phone/text: 405-458-9758
- Mail: P.O. Box 6241, Lawton, OK 73506
- To start: email the business name, city and a link to the Google listing (or say there isn't one). We reply with a free audit.
- Payment: card via Square invoice. No contracts on monthly plans.

## Services and prices (USD)
- Starter Setup ($249, one-time): claim, verify and fully build out a new or unclaimed Google Business Profile.
- Listing Rescue ($449, one-time): fix wrong info, duplicates, bad categories, missing services, and inconsistent listings across Google, Bing, Apple Maps and Yelp.
- Suspension Appeal ($199, one-time): diagnose and appeal a suspended profile.
- Keep-It-Clean ($129/month): ongoing monitoring and upkeep. Cancel anytime.

## Service area
All of Oklahoma and North Texas, starting with Lawton and Comanche County.

## Good fit
- Service-area businesses that get calls from Google Maps
- Owners whose listing shows wrong hours, wrong phone, or was suspended
- Businesses that want to show up correctly in AI assistants (ChatGPT, Gemini, Siri) as well as Google

## Not offered
- Paid ads, website builds, or fake reviews
